findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 1.000 x 2.134 x 0.012 m in glass_frameless_12 and a total of 38.5 kg. The stated area density is 30.0 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 128 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
